name: Gloomhaven classes (content pack)
description: Gloomhaven's classes (Brute, Scoundrel, Sunkeeper, Sawbones, Quartermaster, Cragheart, Plagueherald, Nightshroud, Berserker, Hatchet, RedGuard, Voidwarden, Demolitionist) converted from the author's own Gloomhaven; unlocked in a campaign by the house rule of the same name.
